title: Writers who don’t read
text:
Title: Writers who don’t read

I have always loved to read. A day that permits me an hour of reading before having to get out of bed perks 
me up better than coffee. I also consider myself a writer. I’ve been kept awake at night thinking about and 
working on a story and found myself with finished pieces that I can’t recall how they actually took shape; 
I’ve also struggled and felt like giving up. While the moments of magic happen, writing, for me, is hard work and at times incredibly frustrating.

Reading, on the other hand, is not a struggle. It is an utter pleasure. And it is in this pleasure 
where I first took up the challenge of writing, in trying to emulate the wordsmiths whose stories possessed me so completely that the rest of the world would fade away so long as I kept turning the pages and allowed their words to fuel my imagination.
